description:
Non-material amendment to Planning Permission 24/1459/HOT to allow for:
1. A sedum green roof finish to the rear extension roofs (resulting in a minor 80mm increase in total roof height)
2. Substitution of 5-panel bi-folding doors with sliding doors on the ground floor rear extension.
3. Minor revision to the dimensions and positioning of the ground floor rear extension window.
4. General fenestration refinements, including window replacements maintaining the same proportions and dimensions;
5. Internal layout updates, including new staircase in the same configuration and revised bathroom layouts, as shown on the submitted drawings.
decision_conditions:
For the avoidance of doubt the Drawing No.s to which this decision refers are as follows:
Proposed Drawings Nos. 1201 Proposed First Floor Plan, 1202 Proposed Second Floor Plan, 3200 Proposed Elevations, all prepared by the Applicant and receieved 16 March 2026.
Proposed Drawing 9900 Sedium Roof Build-up, prepared by the Applicant and receieved 12 March 2026.
